name: Humungoopsaur
abilities: Anti-Gravity Projector (white) holds the slime body together
weaknesses: No weaknesses documented on the wiki; a Goop-type body implies dependence on the Anti-Gravity Projector
Slime body may struggle to hold heavy objects/apply leverage despite its strength
summary: Ben 10,000's Biomnitrix fusion of Humungousaur and Goop: a dinosaur-shaped mass of shape-shifting slime with Humungousaur's strength, kept in shape by a floating white projector. The last alien to debut in the Classic continuity.
traits: Last alien to debut in the Classic continuity
Concept art by Thomas N. Perkins IV
notableFeats: Fought alongside Kai Tennyson to recapture Dr. Animo before he escaped through the Chronoporter (The End of an Era)

appearances.designNotes: Humungousaur's general body shape made entirely of Goop's green slime, with Goop's fingers and spikes on head and shoulders; a white recolour of Humungousaur's sash carries the Biomnitrix symbol; a white version of Goop's Anti-Gravity Projector floats above him.

scoring.rationale: Humungousaur strength in a Goop body that reshapes and reforms, plus growth - a durable, regenerating bruiser. Only one short scene (chasing Dr. Animo) and, like Goop, presumably reliant on its projector, so weakness penalty applied.

notes: One-time form used only by the Omniverse Ben 10,000 via the Biomnitrix (The End of an Era, OV S8).
The Biomnitrix adds the Anti-Gravity Projector as a safety extension for this fusion.

Biomnitrix context: the Omniverse Ben 10,000 (Original Future timeline, re-established as Ben Prime's true future) wears two linked Omnitrix gauntlets; slamming them together fuses two aliens on the fly (combinations are generated at transformation time, not stored). Each gauntlet alone gives normal aliens; it is voice-controlled and can be knocked out by a large EMP or Chronosapien time-freeze. All on-screen fusions were drawn by Thomas N. Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).
